description: Partition complete rows by exact selected field tuples, with caller-specified group order and original member order.

interface.semantic_input: An ordered finite row producer with source positions and byte-valued fields, plus a nonempty list of key columns and a group-order selector.
interface.semantic_output: Owned ordered groups with exact key tuples and complete positioned input rows in encounter order within each group.

abstraction: ordered row producer to ordered groups
implementation_form: retained C++ adapter with extracted DuckDB grouping kernels
resources: The adapter materializes input rows and grouping keys before returning owned groups. Maximum input size, throughput and memory use are unmeasured.

preconditions.detail: Supply a valid nonempty list of zero-based key indices and encounter, asc or desc. Selected columns must exist in each reached row.

postconditions.detail: Grouping matched exact frozen key tuples. Encounter, ascending and descending order agreed with the reference, and member fields, duplicate occurrences and signed source positions were preserved.

refinements.detail: Frozen tests covered prefix-related composite keys, case-sensitive keys, an empty key, embedded NUL, repeated key columns and byte-ordered numeric spellings.

effects.detail: Ordinary flatten and count programs wrote the expected bytes. The late missing-key case preserved an existing destination or left an absent one absent.

invariants.detail: Two sequential calls on each frozen producer returned identical groups and consumed the producer once per call.

mathematical_properties.detail: General partition laws and complexity have no formal proof in this package.

formal_predicates.detail: The detached domain identifies finite tested arguments and fixtures.

state_protocol.detail: Recorded malformed arguments failed before reading. A missing selected field or upstream error prevented return of the groups.

ownership.detail: The eager call returns owned groups. A complete row is copied into local storage during visitation.

concurrency.detail: Concurrent grouping and upstream producer side effects were outside the measured tests.

upstream_usage.detail: The adapter uses BLOB keys and the registered brick_list aggregate. Retained historical instrumentation records the list factory and group partition symbol executing.

specification_question.detail: Which field tuple defines a group, and should groups follow first encounter or ascending or descending key order?
